articles.company_name: USA Compression Partners LP Common Units Representing Limited Partner Interests
articles.summary: USA Compression Partners, LP (TXSE: USAC) (“USA Compression”) today announced a cash distribution of $0.525 per common unit ($2.10 on an annualized basis) for the third quarter of 2026. The distribution will be paid on November 6, 2026 to unitholders of record as of the close of business on October 26, 2026.
